# configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf:
user www-data;
worker_processes auto;
events {
	worker_connections 768;
}
http {
	include /etc/nginx/mime.types;
	include /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf;
	include /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/*;
}
stream {
	upstream db { server 10.0.0.5:5432; }
	server {
		listen 5432;
		proxy_pass db;
	}
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/morcheh.conf:
# Managed by Morcheh: sites added in the panel live in /etc/nginx/morcheh/hosts.
map $http_upgrade $morcheh_connection {
    default upgrade;
    ''      close;
}
include /etc/nginx/morcheh/hosts/*.conf;

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default:
server {
	listen 80 default_server;
	listen [::]:80 default_server;
	root /var/www/html;
	server_name _;
	location / {
		try_files $uri $uri/ =404; # comment with { brace
	}
}

server {
	listen 443 ssl http2;
	server_name shop.example.com "www.shop.example.com";
	ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/shop.example.com/fullchain.pem;
	location /api/ {
		proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8080/;
		set $x "a;b}";
	}
	location ~ ^/old/(.*)$ {
		return 301 https://new.example.com/$1;
	}
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/morcheh/hosts/0193.conf:
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name app.example.com;
    location / {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000;
    }
}
